item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 12 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 12 FINAL #MINPRSD
Weather System: Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)
Issued at 02:00 AM 27 September 2026

All Rainfall Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are still advised to MONITOR the weather condition.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 01:35 AM 27 September 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #ZamboangaSibugay(Talusan, Olutanga, Mabuhay), #Bukidnon(Sumilao, ImpasugOng) and #ZamboangaCity within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #ZamboangaSibugay(Tungawan) and #DinagatIslands(Cagdianao) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
